title: West Region Provider Handbook Note on Unbilled Final Stay Days, Referrals and Authorizations
content:
Under **Referrals and Authorizations**, when a Skilled Nursing Facility Authorization or Inpatient Mental Health Authorization covered under TRICARE Select lapses, days the facility has not billed yet are held, because a facility may bill a stay's last days up to the claims filing deadline.

## Records consulted

- The facility line: the facility claim line most recently posted under the authorization; its last covered day is its service date plus its covered inpatient days, less one day.
- From the patient's TRICARE Select claim lines: the most recent home health visit, the most recent acute inpatient admission and the most recent emergency department visit, each by service date.

## Handbook terms

1. Where the facility line's last covered day falls before the span's last day and the patient's most recent home health visit is dated after the span's last day (the stay ran to the span's last day, which is its discharge day and not a covered day), the days from the day after the line's last covered day up to, but not counting, the span's last day are held.
2. Where the line's last covered day falls before the span's last day and no home health visit, acute inpatient admission or emergency department visit of the patient is dated after the line's last covered day (the patient is taken to have stayed through the span), the days from the day after the line's last covered day through the span's last day are held.
3. Otherwise nothing is held.

## Examples (hypothetical; span 1 March to 14 March, facility line's last covered day 9 March)

| Later care on record | Days held |
|---|---|
| most recent home health visit on 16 March | 4 (10 to 13 March; 14 March, the discharge day, not counted) |
| no home health visit, admission or emergency visit after 9 March | 5 (10 to 14 March) |
| emergency visit on 11 March, no home health visit after 14 March | 0 |
| facility line's last covered day on 14 March itself | 0 |
